title: Why Did She Leave Her Jar?
thread: A Samaritan woman came to a well for water; Jesus, a Jew, asked her for a drink and offered living water, a gift from God, a spring that never runs dry; He told her the truth of her life, knew it all, and stayed; He said He is the Christ; she left her jar and told the town; many called Him the Saviour of the world; He died for our sins and rose the third day
